## Review checklist

- [ ] Change is scoped to the declared task and repository boundary.
- [ ] Tests cover success, failure and invalid-input behavior where applicable.
- [ ] Evidence is reproducible and is not mock output or an unsupported number.
- [ ] Generated files are ignored or have manifest/checksum provenance.
- [ ] Ground truth was not changed after inspecting predictions.
- [ ] No secret, PII or private source is present in logs/artifacts.
- [ ] Relevant README, ADR, task status and paper claim matrix are updated.
- [ ] CI passes and a non-author reviewer has reviewed the result.
